purpose: Teach: 大笑い/ぱっと/ぺん/愛犬/老化/タメ/木製/無茶

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんの話で、大笑いしてくれたね、本当に、嬉しいよ、メイ姉さん、いつも。
lines.en: Sho, you laughed so hard at what I was telling you — it really made me happy. I love these moments with you.
lines.style: Warm, unhurried opening. Soft smile in the voice. Speaks with genuine affection, not performed brightness. Lets the words land gently.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼく、お外で、お友達、見つけると、ぱっと、走り出すんだよ、メイ姉さん、見て、ね。
lines.en: When I'm outside and I spot a friend, I just take off running. Watch me, Mei-sis!
lines.style: Quick energy, eager to show off. Bounces slightly in delivery. Opens bright, wants immediate reaction. The rush of a six-year-old in motion.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 動物のぺんぎん、メイ姉さん、子供の頃、大好きだったの、覚えてないかな、お母さんに、聞いてみて。
lines.en: You know, I loved penguins so much when I was a kid — do you remember? Maybe ask your mom about it sometime.
lines.style: Distant, nostalgic tone. Slower pace, looking backward. Gentle suggestion at the end, not pushing. Quiet wonder about time passing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うちの愛犬、メイ姉さん、覚えてる?名前、ぽち、なんだよ、可愛いんだ、いつも。
lines.en: Do you remember our family dog? His name is Pochi — he's so cute. I always think about him.
lines.style: Animated but genuine. Direct questions to her, testing if she's really listening. Slight proud note on the name. Bright without being performed.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さんも、もう、すぐ、老化、気になる年齢なのよ、翔くん、信じられる?早いね、時間って。
lines.en: Can you believe it? I'm already at the age where I worry about getting older. Time goes so fast.
lines.style: Wry smile underneath. Self-aware, a little bemused at herself. Not seeking reassurance, just noticing out loud. Slight irony in the delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さんとは、タメ口で、話していいんだよね、ぼく、嬉しいんだ、特別、感じるよ。
lines.en: It makes me really happy that I can talk to you casually like this. It feels special.
lines.style: Sincere, unguarded. Small vulnerable moment. Quiet conviction — not asking for validation, just telling the truth. Steady eye-contact level of intimacy.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 公園の木製のベンチ、座って、ゆっくり、お話しようね、翔くん、お弁当、持ってきたよ。
lines.en: Let's sit on that wooden bench in the park and talk slowly for a while, yeah? I brought us lunch.
lines.style: Gentle invitation. Unhurried pace. Opens soft, settles into calm. The voice of someone making space. Practical care wrapped in tenderness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 無茶な高さから、ジャンプ、しないように、ぼく、約束するよ、メイ姉さん、心配かけないように、ね。
lines.en: I promise I won't jump from crazy heights, okay? I don't want to worry you, Mei-sis.
lines.style: Earnest, protective tone — but reversed, the child protecting the adult. Small, steady voice. No bravado. Matter-of-fact promise, like a serious contract between them.
